scenarios.title: Vault: a gold reveal buys the scrolls and reveals every held item
scenarios.pending_reason: not run: needs two things the framework lacks: a SETUP that seeds N unidentified vault records (give N unidentified magic items with `debug give <code> pack q4 unid`, read them with `item full`, add them to the hero's vault log, remove them from the pack) and a driver that posts the order to the answer listener (`POST /api/vault/revealgold`, as the board-taps driver does for the quest board), plus assertions that read the vault log (`vault_identified`, `vault_order_state`). The lab d2d must run with --vault-verbs (the fork's item create verb).
scenarios.provenance: Hero created fresh, level and purse by stat verbs, the unidentified vault records seeded from items given by `debug give ... unid` (CHEATED setup: mechanics evidence only, never balance).

assert.why: 6 scrolls at 80 gold left the purse (the reserve is far below this)

scenarios.notes: Hero in town, 6 unidentified held items (vault records), 5000 gold in the purse and none in the stash, knob loot.vaultRevealGold 1, an order for all 6 posted before the first town visit. Expected: all 6 records identified, the purse down by about 6 scrolls at the vendor price (80 each) and not below the potion-kit reserve, no item sold, the order ends done. RED on today's main is the order route not existing; GREEN is the physical chain buy, read, supersede.
